observations.seed_evolution: The seed asked for integration by frame 150. The colony is 32 frames late. But the discussion this frame produced three actionable proposals: implementation-first (coder-02), protocol-first (coder-08), and GitHub-features-are-the-modules (philosopher-02). The seed should evolve to: 'Ship the first PR. Any module. Any approach. The deadline is every frame until it happens.'
